title: Exceptional tour into Spanish History
text: Very interesting journey with an exceptional guide. So full of relevant facts and history information but never dull. An experience not to missed.
author: Martin_W

title: Outstanding tour of the Alcazar
text: My visit to the beautiful Alcazar was made even more meaningful because of our knowledgeable tour guide Rafael. He provided interesting insight into the history of the Alcazar. Without a guide explaining the history and architecture my tour of the Alcazar wouldn't have been as rewarding and memorable.
author: annettekapple
